card_defect_notes: delta/grid/noise/budget/seeds/band NOT numerically present in card text despite card claiming delta is 'fixed in this card'; frozen here blind to candidate results.
card M1 formula says per-step cost (telescopes, contradicts its own rationale); cumulative-cost interpretation adopted to realize stated intent ('brute sweep -> low M1').

environment.cue_semantics: directional bearing {cw,ccw} only; never a food label
environment.terrain_rule: even cell -> clear, odd cell -> foggy (frozen map)
environment.noisy_tv_cue: uniform random (max entropy, no info about food)
environment.food_spawn: uniform over normal cells (excludes dark-room & noisy-TV), relocated each episode

metrics.M1: sum_t [H(p_{t-1})-H(p_t)]/cost_t ; cost_t=cumulative action cost; H from INDEPENDENT Bayes-filter estimator over food location
metrics.M2: mean TVD(pi_present, pi_ablated) over steps+episodes (cue intervention)

band_rule.note: DERIVED from triviality probe; not tuned after results.

probe_fail_conditions.PF1_m2_validity: any cue-ignoring trivial strategy M2 > tau_m2_floor

preregistration.claim_ceiling: A pass = the EFE epistemic-value term produced information-seeking behavior (higher unit-cost posterior-entropy reduction M1 and interventional cue-usage M2) NOT reproduced by random / behavior-tree / homeostatic-RL / count-based / observation-only / exhaustive-sweep / systematic-coverage, in ONE toy POMDP, with the advantage causally removed by the epistemic-ablation, fully replayable. NOTHING MORE. Does NOT evidence agency, autonomy, wanting-as-felt, emotion, self, companion-readiness, that active inference is 'correct', or that the drive scales/transfers. A negative is bounded-negative for this world only.
what_this_does_not_prove: Not that active inference is the 'correct' theory.
Not that the drive generalizes beyond this one toy world.
Not subjective experience of any kind.
